command_redacted:
n=0; until ssh -o ConnectTimeout=15 -o BatchMode=yes m1 'cat > /tmp/rentular-deploy.sh <<"EOF"
set -e
cd /var/www/rentular.com
echo "[deploy] pull"; git pull origin main 2>&1 | tail -3
echo "[deploy] install"; pnpm install 2>&1 | tail -4
export DB_PASSWORD="$(grep -m1 "^DB_PASSWORD=" .env | cut -d= -f2-)"
export AUTH_SECRET="$(grep -m1 "^AUTH_SECRET=" .env | cut -d= -f2-)"
echo "[deploy] build web"; pnpm --filter @rentular/web build 2>&1 | tail -6
echo "[deploy] restart"; pm2 restart /var/www/rentular.com/ecosystem.config.cjs 2>&1 | tail -6
echo "[deploy] DONE"
EOF
echo script-written' 2>/tmp/sshfail; do n=$((n+1)); [ $n -ge 15 ] && { echo giveup; cat /tmp/sshfail; break; }; sleep 8; done
